svg.title: Actual rHEALPix cell footprints on a longitude latitude map
svg.text: WGS84 rHEALPix cell footprints in geographic coordinates
Resolution-1 cells shown in longitude/latitude; root-face boundaries are heavier. Polar cells visibly fold and converge.
The antimeridian is split at the map edge exactly as a GIS renderer should handle wrapped geometry.
